# A flower (generated by make_env.py).
new
material new Stalk --base-color 0.165 0.345 0.310 --no-slot
material new Petal --base-color 0.776 0.314 0.353 --no-slot
material new Heart --base-color 0.933 0.612 0.365 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Stalk --vertices 4 --radius 0.03 --depth 0.45 --location 0 0 0.22
material assign Stalk
add mesh cylinder --name Petals --vertices 5 --radius 0.16 --depth 0.05 --location 0 0 0.46
material assign Petal
add mesh ico-sphere --name Heart --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.06 --location 0 0 0.5
material assign Heart
select all
shade flat
export flower.glb
